ops.sql: SELECT x.Type, x.Client, x.Supplier, u.UserLogin, g.GroupName FROM t_xrefsystem x LEFT JOIN t_object o ON o.ea_guid = x.Supplier LEFT JOIN t_secuser u ON u.UserID = x.Client LEFT JOIN t_secgroup g ON g.GroupID = x.Client WHERE x.Type IN ('UserSettings', 'GroupSettings') AND o.Object_ID IS NULL ORDER BY x.Supplier, x.Type, x.Client
